title.value: A Probabilistic Framework for Mutation Testing in Deep Neural Networks
title.justification: The title explicitly states the main focus of the paper, which is proposing a probabilistic framework for mutation testing in deep neural networks.
title.quote: A Probabilistic Framework for Mutation Testing in Deep Neural Networks

extractions.description: This paper addresses the challenges of Mutation Testing in Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) by proposing a Probabilistic Mutation Testing (PMT) approach. The approach adapts traditional mutation testing techniques to account for the stochasticity in DNN training, ensuring more consistent and reliable test results. The paper evaluates this framework using different models and mutation operators, comparing it to existing methods, and provides insights on reducing the inconsistency and flakiness of previous methodologies.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is mutation testing for deep neural networks, focusing on software testing methodology rather than climate or ecological sustainable development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Context: Mutation Testing (MT) is an important tool in traditional Software Engineering (SE) white-box testing.
